detailPanel.title: Page details
detailPanel.loadFailed: Details could not load. Try Open as full page.
title: Collections
chooseCollection: Select a collection or create one.
savedRefreshFailed: Saved. Reload to refresh the displayed data.
conflict: Other changes were saved first. Your input is preserved. Reload to review.
uncertain: The save result is unknown. Input is preserved and further writes are stopped. Reload to review.
invalidResponse: The response could not be verified. Input is preserved.
unavailable: The operation could not be completed.
tooLarge: The data exceeds the storage limit.
viewDependency: A saved view uses this property. Update that view first.
typeImmutable: An existing property type cannot be changed. Add a new property.
accountChanged: The account changed. Operations are stopped.
accessChanged: Access is no longer available. Operations are stopped.
signInHint: Sign in with a verified account.
discardDraft: Discard unsaved input and reload current saved data? If a previous save result was unknown, review the reloaded data.
rowPermission: Record title and values use their respective edit permissions.
sourceHint: Original strings captured during import. Editing values does not change this reference. Manually created records have no original cells.
trashHint: Move this record page to trash. Restore it from workspace trash.
schemaHint: Existing types are preserved. Changing properties requires manage access to every row, including hidden rows. Required properties cannot leave existing rows empty.
optionsHint: One option per line. Values must be unique.
deletePropertyConsent: I understand that removing properties deletes their current values from all rows. Original imported cells remain.
personHint: Choose a currently verified workspace member. The reference is rechecked when saving.
relationHint: Select readable record pages. Multiple selections are supported.
deleteViewHint: Only the saved view is removed. Records and properties are preserved.
filtersHint: Records must match every rule. Filters are applied on the server.
redactedFilter: This reference is unavailable. Remove the rule or explicitly choose a replacement value.
outsideRange: Outside month, missing dates, or reversed range
redactedValue: This reference is unavailable and cannot be viewed or edited. Other properties remain editable.
computedReadOnly: Computed results cannot be edited directly. Change the source values, expression or rollup settings.
formulaReadOnly: Results are read-only and recalculate after row values are saved. Formula fields are not sent as editable values.
formulaSyntaxHint: Example: field("property-id") * 2. Only saved values in this row are referenced. No JavaScript or external access runs.
formulaFieldHint: References use IDs, not names. Person and relation fields cannot be referenced. Multi-select fields can only be used with length().
formulaNotReviewed: The expression has not been reviewed yet.
formulaValid: The expression and references are valid.
formulaInvalid: Check the expression, result type and references. Your input is preserved.
formulaPreviewAfterCreate: Save a new collection before previewing its expressions.
formulaPreviewBoundary: Other properties and row values use saved data. Other unsaved schema changes are not included. This action does not save.
FORMULA_NUMBER_RANGE: Cannot calculate: number is out of range.
FORMULA_NUMBER_FORMAT: Cannot calculate: value is not a valid number.
FORMULA_STRING_LIMIT: Cannot calculate: text is too long.
FORMULA_INPUT_TYPE: Cannot calculate: input type does not match.
FORMULA_RESULT_TYPE: Cannot calculate: result type does not match.
FORMULA_REDACTED_INPUT: The result is hidden because an input is unavailable.
formulaResultHint: The result must match this type. Filters, sorts and date views use this type.
formulaFunctions: Functions: if, coalesce, empty, length, concat, lower, upper, trim, toText, toNumber, round, min, max, abs, ceil, floor, date, dateAdd, dateBetween
rollupReadOnly: Saved values from related records are aggregated. Results are read-only and are not sent as editable values.
rollupHint: Aggregate records in a relation field from one selected collection, using a single hop.
rollupRelationHint: Choose a relation field in this collection. Its values determine the records to aggregate.
rollupCountHint: Count does not need a target property. An empty relation returns 0.
rollupRawTypes: Sum accepts number fields. Minimum and maximum accept number or date fields. Formula and rollup fields are excluded.
rollupNotReviewed: The rollup settings have not been reviewed yet.
rollupValid: The rollup settings and references are valid.
rollupInvalid: Check the relation, target collection, aggregation and target property. Your input is preserved.
rollupPreviewAfterCreate: Save a new collection before previewing its rollups.
rollupPreviewBoundary: Targets use saved properties and values. Other unsaved schema changes are excluded. This action does not save.
rollupHiddenSchema: A rollup target is currently unavailable. Property settings cannot be saved while this projected definition remains. Review access, or explicitly remove the property and confirm deletion.
ROLLUP_REDACTED_INPUT: The rollup is unavailable because a target cannot be opened.
ROLLUP_SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE: The target property or a related record is unavailable.
ROLLUP_LIMIT: The rollup limit has been reached.
ROLLUP_NUMBER_RANGE: The rollup result exceeds the number range.
ROLLUP_UNAVAILABLE: The rollup could not be calculated.
chartBoundary: Only readable rows are aggregated. Hidden values or calculation errors stop the entire aggregate. Use a select property to group statuses.
chartNullHint: Blank numbers are excluded from sums and average denominators. An all-blank sum is 0; its average has no number.
chartDescription: Aggregated values by group. The following table provides group labels, aggregate values and row counts.
CHART_INPUT_UNAVAILABLE: The aggregate is unavailable because an input is hidden or has a calculation error. Check filter and sort inputs too.
CHART_GROUP_LIMIT: More than 128 groups. Narrow the records with a filter.
CHART_NUMBER_RANGE: The numbers exceed the safe aggregation range.
CHART_NEGATIVE_DONUT: A donut cannot display negative aggregates. Choose a bar chart.
feedBoundary: Readable record titles and properties follow the saved filters and order. Page bodies, comments and view counts are not included.
localeFallbackNotice: Some labels use English. Page names and content are not translated.
boardMoveHint: Only the property used for grouping changes. Page content and original cells stay unchanged.
boardDragHint: Drag a card before another card, or to the bottom of a group. Hold its handle on touch screens, or press Space and use the arrow keys with the keyboard.
boardMoved: Saved the card's group and position.
boardOrderHint: The group and position are saved together for this view. Filtered and hidden records keep their positions.
boardAtEnd: At the end of this group
boardSorted: Manual ordering is unavailable while this view has a sort. You can still change the group using the card menu.
boardOrderReadOnly: Saving a shared view's manual order requires full access to the collection. You can still change a writable card's group using its menu.
boardEmptyGroup: No visible items in this group.
boardComputed: Groups based on computed results cannot be moved. Edit their source values or calculation settings.
boardReference: Moving groups based on person references is not supported. Use the property editor.
boardUnsupported: Moving this kind of group is not supported.
boardRedacted: This item cannot move because its group value is unavailable.
boardReadOnly: You do not have permission to edit this item’s properties.
boardTargetUnavailable: This destination is not available in the current view. Reload to review it.
boardDndInstructions: Press Space to pick up, then use the arrow keys to move. Press Space or Enter to drop, or Esc to cancel.
boardDndInvalid: Choose a different card position or group.
boardDndUnavailable: Drag and drop is unavailable. Choose "Move to group" on the card.
conversionTitle: Create a number or date column
conversionHint: Create a new column from a text column. Keep the original column, source cells, existing views and formulas. Review every row before saving.
conversionFormat: Use decimal numbers or YYYY-MM-DD dates. Group separators, exponents, surrounding whitespace and numeric rounding are rejected. Empty strings and unset values become null.
conversionTrashHint: All rows are included, even rows in trash. Nothing is saved if any value cannot be converted.
conversionConsent: I reviewed every row and agree to create a new column while keeping the original column.
conversionFormConsent: This change stops form acceptance. I understand that I must review and republish the form.
CONVERSION_INVALID_NUMBER: This text cannot be converted to a number.
CONVERSION_NUMBER_PRECISION: This number cannot be represented without losing precision.
CONVERSION_INVALID_DATE: This is not a valid YYYY-MM-DD calendar date.
settingsDialog.title: Sharing
settingsDialog.unavailable: Sharing could not be loaded. Close and try again.
embeddedPropertiesChanged: The view was not switched because your input changed. Your property draft has been kept.
embeddedDiscardProperties: Discard unsaved property changes and switch views? Your body draft will be kept.
assigneeNotificationLimit: Nothing was saved because the notification limit was reached.
statusOptionsHint: Enter states in order: not started, in progress, then done, one per line.
templateHint: Apply a page body and property defaults together. Each created page can be edited independently.
templateBodyHint: You are editing a template body. It applies to records created after this edit.
templateRemoveHint: Remove this choice from new records. Its body remains as a regular page, and existing records are unchanged.
templateSaveFailed: Could not save. Refresh the view and try again.
